735:     pub fn merge(self, other: MethodRouter<ReqBody, E>) -> Self {
736:         macro_rules! merge {
737:             ( $first:ident, $second:ident ) => {
738:                 match ($first, $second) {
739:                     (Some(_), Some(_)) => panic!(concat!(
740:                         "Overlapping method route. Cannot merge two method routes that both define `",
741:                         stringify!($first),
742:                         "`"
743:                     )),
744:                     (Some(svc), None) => Some(svc),
745:                     (None, Some(svc)) => Some(svc),
746:                     (None, None) => None,
747:                 }
748:             };
749:         }
750: 
751:         let Self {
752:             get,
753:             head,
754:             delete,
755:             options,
756:             patch,
757:             post,
758:             put,
759:             trace,
760:             fallback,
761:             allow_header,
762:             _request_body: _,
763:         } = self;
764: 
765:         let Self {
766:             get: get_other,
767:             head: head_other,
768:             delete: delete_other,
769:             options: options_other,
770:             patch: patch_other,
771:             post: post_other,
772:             put: put_other,
773:             trace: trace_other,
774:             fallback: fallback_other,
775:             allow_header: allow_header_other,
776:             _request_body: _,
777:         } = other;
778: 
779:         let get = merge!(get, get_other);
780:         let head = merge!(head, head_other);
781:         let delete = merge!(delete, delete_other);
782:         let options = merge!(options, options_other);
783:         let patch = merge!(patch, patch_other);
784:         let post = merge!(post, post_other);
785:         let put = merge!(put, put_other);
786:         let trace = merge!(trace, trace_other);
787: 
788:         let fallback = match (fallback, fallback_other) {
789:             (pick @ Fallback::Default(_), Fallback::Default(_)) => pick,
790:             (Fallback::Default(_), pick @ Fallback::Custom(_)) => pick,
791:             (pick @ Fallback::Custom(_), Fallback::Default(_)) => pick,
792:             (Fallback::Custom(_), Fallback::Custom(_)) => {
793:                 panic!("Cannot merge two `MethodRouter`s that both have a fallback")
794:             }
795:         };
796: 
797:         let allow_header = match (allow_header, allow_header_other) {
798:             (AllowHeader::Skip, _) | (_, AllowHeader::Skip) => AllowHeader::Skip,
799:             (AllowHeader::None, AllowHeader::None) => AllowHeader::None,
800:             (AllowHeader::None, AllowHeader::Bytes(pick)) => AllowHeader::Bytes(pick),
801:             (AllowHeader::Bytes(pick), AllowHeader::None) => AllowHeader::Bytes(pick),
802:             (AllowHeader::Bytes(mut a), AllowHeader::Bytes(b)) => {
803:                 a.extend_from_slice(b",");
804:                 a.extend_from_slice(&b);
805:                 AllowHeader::Bytes(a)
806:             }
807:         };
808: 
809:         Self {
810:             get,
811:             head,
812:             delete,
813:             options,
814:             patch,
815:             post,
816:             put,
817:             trace,
818:             fallback,
819:             allow_header,
820:             _request_body: PhantomData,
821:         }
822:     }
